result.edit: The public failure shows incorrect mode switching at cycle=5. The current AND condition for mode toggle (cyc_cnt==M_N-1 && cyc_cnt==c89-1) can never be true since M_N and c89 are different. Changing to OR condition (||) matches the specification's requirement to toggle mode when cycle_count equals either M_N-1 or c89-1. This should fix the mode switching behavior while preserving all other timing and reset requirements.
